terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.hint.gener: Prepared only uses flat unprepared terrain.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.hint.perfo: Adaptive is experimental; it needs on demand.

terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.restart: TD settings: save and restart the game.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.bounds.vox: Enable Voxy rendering on the Visibility page.
Open native Voxy settings: enable the mod and rendering, distance, fog and threads. Distant LOD needs Voxy rendering enabled.
Open Iris for shader selection and the shader settings, including fog.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.photon_cle: Apply now: Overworld fog at 10%, border fog off. Other Photon settings stay intact. The shader will recompile.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.photon_nor: Apply now: Overworld fog at 100%, border fog on. Other settings are preserved.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.visual_err: Could not apply; see the log for details
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.in: GPU, CPU or auto. Requires restart. CPU builds ignore this choice.
On: lazy cache and single-session memory fallback. Off: all models stay in VRAM.
1–3 sessions. 3 avoids model reloading; 1 saves VRAM. Used with VRAM management on.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.va: Verify model asset SHA-256. Disable to allow custom model files.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.sp: Spawn search start: 1–1024 coarse pixels, at most the limit.
Spawn search limit: 1–1024 coarse pixels, at least the initial size.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.ti: Power of two, 16–1024 blocks. A larger tile increases each work batch.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.pr: On demand computes new data. Prepared only uses ready data and a temporary plain elsewhere. World Scale is chosen at world creation.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.pe: Terrain disk cache: 1024–1048576 MB. This does not limit the world save.
Legacy raw-tile preparation ahead. Adaptive requires on-demand mode.
Prepare terrain, catchments, channels and banks ahead. Adaptive follows load signals, one stage at a time.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.co: Supply TD terrain to Voxy. This does not enable Voxy rendering itself.
Coordinate VoxyWorldGen 2.2.4 and TD streaming. Keep on when WorldGen is installed.
Prepared TD source only: prepare missing data in the background. In real chunk mode Chunky handles generation.
Use the actual generated crown geometry in the optional prepared-data exporter. Real chunks always contain their complete trees.
Neural distant preview without base/decoder or real chunks. Terrain becomes more detailed nearby.
Prepared TD source only: Auto reads the WorldGen radius; Manual uses the field below. Real chunk horizons are configured in Voxy/Chunky.
64–32768 blocks of radius; 16 blocks = 1 chunk. For 2048 chunks use 32768 and Manual mode. Voxy render distance must also be sufficient.
256–8192 blocks: cap for the optional prepared TD preview. Does not limit native Voxy/Chunky real chunk distance.
Renders an experimental neural horizon beyond real chunks. Restart required.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.pe: Writes frozen water plans in the background when queue space is available. Restart required.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.co: Voxy ingests real Minecraft and Chunky chunks. Prepared TD also exports prepared terrain. Restart to apply.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.bounds.com: Voxy and Chunky control distance and pregeneration.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.co: Share European Wilderness heights, rivers and lakes with supported Road Weaver versions. Restart to apply.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.water.new_: New worlds generate rivers, lakes and waterfalls automatically.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.water.auto: This world · automatic rivers, lakes and waterfalls
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.water.prep: This world · water in prepared areas
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.ri: Enables currents in new and existing rivers.
Lets the current carry dropped items.
100% is the original strength. 0% stops the current.
Changes local variations in new channels. Base width still depends on the catchment.
Changes extra local variation in the depth of new river channels.
Allow river channels above the foothill height. Off keeps high terrain free of rivers and leaves lakes and rivers in lower valleys.
Higher values require a larger or deeper basin for a new lake.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.na: Adds selected decorations to new chunks if the Fabric mod is installed.
Share of Geophilic placement attempts to keep. 100% uses the original frequency.
Adds selected plants and leaf litter to new chunks when the mod is installed.
Share of Wilder Wild placement attempts to keep. 100% uses the original frequency.
Changes the density of European Wilderness trees in new chunks.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.an: Scales Alex’s Mobs spawn weights relative to other mobs. 0% disables these entries.
Allows Alex’s Mobs land and flying creatures in biome spawn lists.
Allows aquatic entries from Alex’s Mobs in biome spawn lists.
Allows hostile entries from Alex’s Mobs in biome spawn lists.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.te: Saved when creating a world. Changes the extra ridge height within the current world height limit.
Saved when creating a world. Adds mixed and sparse forest patches within existing forest regions.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.bounds.riv: Shape settings apply when a water plan is first calculated.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.bounds.nat: Decoration and tree settings apply to newly generated chunks.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.bounds.ani: Applies to biome spawn lists when Alex’s Mobs is installed.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.bounds.ter: These settings are saved when creating a new world.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.profile_sa: Enter a unique name and check the settings before saving.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.preference: Could not read or save menu preferences.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.apply.rest: Save and restart Minecraft or the server to apply this setting.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.apply.new_: Save and restart. This setting affects chunks generated afterward.
Save before creating a new world, or pick a world profile during creation. Existing saves keep their generation profile.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.status.wat: Rebuild water LOD around the player within 16 chunks.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.status.veg: Rebuild vegetation LOD around the player within 32 chunks.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.status.sto: Cancel the current Voxy water rebuild.
Cancel the current Voxy vegetation rebuild.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.status.can: Cancel the current terrain preparation job.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.status.cop: Copy the latest status report to the clipboard.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.status.no_: Open a local European Wilderness world to see its status.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.status.wor: World profile • scale %s • relief %s%% • biome variety %s%% • river width %s%% • depth %s%% • lake threshold %s%%
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.subtitle: Mod settings
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.descriptio: Shape the landscape, mountains and forests.
Terrain range and level of detail.
terrain-diffusion-mc.settings.tooltip.te: Raise or lower uplands to change how much of the map is mountainous. 100% keeps the standard balance.
Move the coastline to trade coastal lowlands for shallow seas, or the reverse. 100% keeps the standard coastline.
Adjust how much warm, dry land becomes desert. 100% keeps the standard balance.
Increase forest area by reducing open fields, or lower it to make room for fields. 100% keeps the standard balance.
Adjust how much forest-suitable land becomes open fields. 100% keeps the standard balance.
Shifts the model temperatures before choosing biomes. Applies when creating a world.
terrain-diffusion-mc.world_settings.spaw: Explorer opened. Mark a point, save the spawn and press Done.
